Health Functional FoodNiacin 15mgMagnesium 94.5mgManganese 3mgVitamin B1 1.2mgVitamin B2 1.4mgVitamin B6 1.5mgSelenium 55μgZinc 8.5mgOnce a day

부스터 에브리비타 젤리스틱Niacin · Magnesium · Manganese · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Selenium · Zinc

Made by (주)네이처텍 · Once a day · 1 sachet

This product combines 15mg of Niacin, 94.5mg of Magnesium, 3mg of Manganese, 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 55μg of Selenium, 8.5mg of Zinc as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 sachet): 15mg Niacin, 94.5mg Magnesium, 3mg Manganese, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 55μg Selenium, 8.5mg Zinc
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)네이처텍

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Magnesium
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
  • Manganese
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 sachet per servingChew to take

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (15mg / 20g), 80~150%
Magnesium labelled (94.5mg / 20g), 80~150%
Manganese labelled (3mg / 20g), 80~150%
Vitamin B1 labelled (1.2mg / 20g), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.4mg / 20g), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.5mg / 20g), 80~150%
Selenium labelled (55μg / 20g), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 20g), 80~150%

Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 18 개월
Storage 1) 직사광선이나 고온 다습한 곳을 피하여 청결하고 서늘한 곳에 밀봉하여 보관하십시오.2) 잘못된 사용 및 남용을 피하고 품질 보존을 위해 다른 용기에 넣지 마십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Magnesium · Manganese · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Selenium · Zinc together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
